10. Portfolio Direction?

Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed signals from falling VXX (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -15.84%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and a flagged HYG/LQD credit signal (Credit Spread 0.7483 | 1W: -0.25% | 1M: +0.36%) CORRECTION. Materials XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +18.60%), Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) and EM EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +7.71%) showing relative strength. Key risk is the short-term divergence with SPY, QQQ and XLK in CORRECTION (1W negative | 1M positive) — monitor credit spreads and XLK/XLF pivot.
